Avoid combination  
Concomitant use of NSAIDs and methotrexate may increase the risk for methotrexate toxicity (e.g., neutropenia, thrombocytopenia, renal dysfunction). Naproxen is an NSAID, and its coadministration with methotrexate requires monitoring for methotrexate toxicity. [naproxen:drug_interactions:7] [methotrexate:drug_interactions:1]
